summary: Derive release fixture versions from canonical sources

delivery.outcome: Remove release-version coupling from adoption and governance test fixtures while preserving version-mismatch refusals, and ship the material fix with release projections for 0.20.28.
nonGoals: No weakening publication provenance, approval or scope gates.
No manual editing of adopter payloads, historical tags or unrelated worktrees.

architecture.decision: Read expected versions from the canonical VERSION or each fixture manifest. Mutate only standard.version for the negative adoption case and guarantee it differs. Keep release projections in this material changeset.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded material fix through a reviewed successor; never move a published tag.

validation.evidence: Version 0.20.28 passes without changing test literals; source, manifest and lock versions remain checked.
Deliberately different standard.version still rejects adoption before target mutation, including a source version equal to the usual mismatch sentinel.
Release projections agree, canonical guidance is current, publication uses Goal and independent exact-head review.
